description: The Symphony by Imtiaz presents a distinctive vision of contemporary luxury, where sculptural architecture, fluid forms, and refined design come together in a harmonious residential concept. Inspired by the architectural philosophy associated with Zaha Hadid, the development embraces expressive curves, geometric precision, and the interplay of light and shadow to create a striking architectural presence. Every element reflects a considered balance between artistic expression and everyday functionality, offering a sophisticated living environment shaped by design and tranquillity. Residences and interiors The residential collection includes elegant 1-bedroom apartments, spacious duplex residences, and refined master suites. Interiors are designed around natural textures, soft lighting, and seamless transitions between living spaces, creating an atmosphere of openness and calm. Open-plan kitchens connect effortlessly with living and dining areas, while private balconies extend the living experience outdoors, framing views of the surrounding cityscape. Thoughtfully planned layouts maximise space and functionality while maintaining the development's distinctive design language. The result is a contemporary home environment where architectural character meets comfort and understated elegance. Amenities and lifestyle The Symphony offers a curated range of amenities designed to support wellness, relaxation, and social connection. The clubhouse features inviting lounge areas, billiards, and a dedicated reading corner, providing comfortable spaces for leisure and interaction. The fitness studio is equipped for mindful movement and full-body training, while the landscaped podium garden introduces a tranquil green retreat within the development. Rooftop and social spaces provide additional settings for relaxation, gathering, and enjoying the surrounding views. Across these shared spaces, thoughtful design and natural elements contribute to an atmosphere of contemporary sophistication. Finishes and smart-home features The interiors combine modern aesthetics with high-quality materials and carefully selected international brands. Bathrooms feature sanitaryware by Villeroy & Boch, technical solutions from Geberit, and designer fittings by Gessi, adding a refined touch to everyday routines. Kitchens and household areas may include appliances from leading brands such as Bosch and Samsung. Smart-home features integrated with Alexa offer added convenience, supporting a more seamless and connected living experience. Together, these details reinforce the development's emphasis on quality, functionality, and considered design. Location and lifestyle Located in Meydan City, The Symphony benefits from a prestigious Dubai address that combines contemporary residential living with open spaces and access to major city destinations. The area is known for the iconic Meydan Racecourse, home to the renowned Dubai World Cup, which brings international attention and a distinctive sporting atmosphere to the neighbourhood. Meydan City also features landscaped gardens, parks, and tree-lined streets, offering opportunities for outdoor recreation, walking, cycling, and community activities. These green spaces provide a welcome contrast to Dubai's dynamic urban environment. With road connections to key destinations across Dubai, Meydan offers access to business districts, shopping venues, dining destinations, and entertainment options. Its combination of modern infrastructure, recreational surroundings, and a prominent address makes it an appealing location for residents seeking a balance between city convenience and a more tranquil residential setting. The Symphony brings together expressive architecture, premium interior details, and thoughtfully designed lifestyle amenities to create a distinctive residential experience in Meydan City.

description:
Harrington Gate Real Estate presents a fully furnished one-bedroom apartment with a large private terrace and hot tub in Terraces Marasi Drive, a boutique residential building by Keymavens on the Dubai Canal in Business Bay. With 1,060.68 sq.ft in total, it suits an owner-occupier or an investor looking for a finished, design-led home.

The U-shaped kitchen is finished in high-gloss slate-grey cabinetry with white worktops, illuminated glass-fronted display cabinets, a gas hob, built-in oven, chimney extractor and washing machine.

The bedroom has a grey upholstered bed, a dressing table and floor-to-ceiling windows facing the terrace, and leads to a glass-fronted walk-in wardrobe. The en-suite bathroom features a glass-enclosed walk-in shower with rain shower and dark marble-effect walls, a vessel basin and a backlit mirror. A separate guest WC serves visitors.

The covered terrace is furnished with an outdoor lounge set, potted palms and a hot tub, and enjoys open views towards the city skyline.

description:
*Imagine You Live Here.*

You wake up at Azizi Raffi. The morning sun pours through your floor-to-ceiling window. Below you, the landscaped gardens of Al Furjan are already alive, kids heading to the playground, joggers on the green path. You are not in the chaos of the city, you are above it.

You make coffee. Your apartment is not just a box, it's thoughtfully planned. Every corner has a purpose. Premium finishes, soft light, space that actually breathes.

You step out. 2 minutes and you are at Al Furjan Metro Station. No car needed. Sheikh Zayed Road is right there, but you don't hear it. You are connected, but still calm.

10 minutes to Ibn Battuta Mall for your morning errands.
15 minutes to Dubai Marina for your evening walk by the water.
20 minutes to Expo City.
25 minutes to Downtown and Burj Khalifa when you want the lights.

You come back home. The temperature-controlled pool is waiting. The gym is fully equipped, empty, quiet. Your car is safe in covered parking. 24/7 security at the gate. This is a *Gated Community. Gardens. Green Community.* Not just words, it's how it feels here.

At night, the whole building glows. AZIZI on the facade, lit up. All windows warm. This is Al Furjan at Twilight, the moment between day and night. And you are in the middle of it.

This is not just an apartment.
This is a ready-to-move-in home.
This is Azizi Raffi. Built by Azizi Developments, for people who want to live, not just invest.

But investors love it too. High rental demand. Long-term appreciation. Because everyone wants what you already have: Location, comfort, and peace of mind.

*Azizi Raffi, Al Furjan. Imagine You Live Here. Now stop imagining.*

description: Project general facts This is a premium waterfront residential development rising on Dubai Islands, where contemporary architecture meets the calm rhythm of the sea. Designed with refined coastal tones and fluid façades, the project reflects a modern interpretation of island living, defined by openness, light, and seamless indoor-outdoor flow. Low-density planning enhances privacy and exclusivity, while landscaped gardens and open lounges create a resort-style ambiance shaped by nature and horizon views. The lifestyle is centered around wellness, leisure, and effortless sophistication. Residents are welcomed through a dedicated VIP drop-off area and enjoy access to an extensive collection of curated amenities, including adult and children's swimming pools, a pavilion clubhouse, outdoor yoga and wellness zones, jogging and walking tracks, mixed landscape gardens with sand and gravel concepts, grand tiered seating areas, covered lounges, and open-to-sky garden seating. The residences are delivered fully furnished and fully designed, incorporating a smart home system and refined interior detailing accessorized by Hermès. Layouts are bright and airy, emphasizing natural light and a smooth transition between interior and exterior spaces. Duplex residences feature elevated privacy and, in select units, private pools, enhancing the exclusive waterfront experience. Sea Cliff by Imtiaz represents a harmonious blend of architectural elegance, intelligent living, and curated luxury in a serene island setting. Location description and benefits Dubai Islands is a visionary development that epitomizes the luxurious and innovative spirit of Dubai. Strategically located along the coast, this ambitious project features a collection of five man-made islands designed to offer a blend of residential, commercial, and leisure spaces. Each island is meticulously planned to provide a unique living experience, surrounded by pristine beaches, lush landscapes, and crystal-clear waters. The islands are connected to the mainland via well-developed infrastructure, ensuring seamless access to the rest of the city. This prime location allows residents and visitors to enjoy the tranquility of island life while being just a short drive away from Dubai's bustling urban centers, including the iconic landmarks and vibrant districts such as Downtown Dubai, Dubai Marina, and Palm Jumeirah. The development includes a range of upscale amenities, including luxury hotels, gourmet dining options, high-end retail outlets, and world-class recreational facilities. Dubai Islands is designed to cater to a diverse array of lifestyles, offering everything from serene residential communities to dynamic entertainment hubs. The project emphasizes sustainability and innovation, incorporating green building practices and advanced technologies to create a harmonious and eco-friendly environment. The project comprises an exclusive collection of 76 one-, two-, and three-bedroom residences, defined by sculptural architecture, flowing terraces, and expansive glazing that frames open sea and skyline views. The building's elegant curves, landscaped podium, and expressive rooftop silhouette create a distinctive presence within the coastal destination of Dubai Islands. The development offers 32 amenities curated across three dedicated lifestyle levels, thoughtfully divided into family, wellness, social, and entertainment experiences. Highlights include a Sanctuary Pool and dedicated children's splash areas, a salt sauna and cold plunge pool for contrast therapy, and a rooftop infinity pool overlooking the sea. Social spaces extend beyond traditional lounges, featuring asunken seating with a fireplace, communal dining terraces, and an outdoor cinema. A rooftop sports lounge and bar, secret garden zones, yoga terraces, and a dedicated entertainment lounge for teens and young adults add a distinctive layer of community-focused living rarely seen in boutique projects on Dubai Islands. Interiors are designed with an emphasis on light, proportion, and refined materiality. Floor-to-ceiling windows enhance openness and natural illumination, while contemporary kitchens integrate premium appliances and generous worktops to balance aesthetics with practicality. Bathrooms are conceived as spa-inspired environments, featuring upscale fittings and sophisticated materials that elevate everyday rituals. Each residence includes dedicated utility areas and private balconies, reinforcing seamless indoor-outdoor living and a sense of tranquil coastal retreat. Location description and benefits Dubai Islands is a visionary development that epitomizes the luxurious and innovative spirit of Dubai. Strategically located along the coast, this ambitious project features a collection of five man-made islands designed to offer a blend of residential, commercial, and leisure spaces. Each island is meticulously planned to provide a unique living experience, surrounded by pristine beaches, lush landscapes, and crystal-clear waters. The islands are connected to the mainland via well-developed infrastructure, ensuring seamless access to the rest of the city. This prime location allows residents and visitors to enjoy the tranquility of island life while being just a short drive away from Dubai's bustling urban centers, including the iconic landmarks and vibrant districts such as Downtown Dubai, Dubai Marina, and Palm Jumeirah. The development includes a range of upscale amenities, including luxury hotels, gourmet dining options, high-end retail outlets, and world-class recreational facilities. Dubai Islands is designed to cater to a diverse array of lifestyles, offering everything from serene residential communities to dynamic entertainment hubs. The project emphasizes sustainability and innovation, incorporating green building practices and advanced technologies to create a harmonious and eco-friendly environment. With its stunning natural beauty, exceptional amenities, and strategic location, Dubai Islands stands as a premier destination for those seeking an unparalleled lifestyle in one of the world's most dynamic cities.

title: Majan, Dubai
description: Binghatti Titania at Majan is a high-rise 38-storey ultra-luxury advanced architectural excellence, above the podium levels, developed by leading Binghatti Developers . Laced with premium of the prime designed exclusive edition studios, 1 and 2-bedroom apartments to satisfy your luxury thirst to redefine the lifestyle. Being inspired from the Mythos tale, and rising with sovereign confidence as 3B+G+4P+32 residential floors with mech. and roof floor from the majan corridor. The tower commands immediate bold attention through a distinctive façade defined by a dark, metallic geometric grid that contrasts deliberately and dramatically against expansive glass surface, between structure and transparency that gives the building a rare character. The architectural philosophy extends far beyond its exterior geometry, threading through every interior surface with an equally precise design. The materials palette chose for the residences reads as a consideration curation of natural and refined elements. Patagonia marble in its two distinct expressions brings both dynamic veining and quiet textural richness to kitchen, bathrooms and entrance areas. Oakwood panelling introduces warmth and organic depth to living and bedroom walls; bronze trims add luminous finish detail to joinery and fixtures; and green brushed steel appears as a signature accent that ties the interior palette to the tower's broader identity. Interiors are conceived around open-plan spatial logic, with light treated not as an amenity but as the primary architectural material, its movement through floor-to-ceiling glazing creates a living, breathing quality of illumination across subtle neutral hues that shift from cream and sand to warm ivory across different times. The result is a residential atmosphere that feels simultaneously expansive and intimate, modern and enduring, a place where the design draws back deliberately to place the resident and their sense of stillness at the centre of every room. The amenity deck has been conceived as a comprehensive lifestyle environment that balances activation and restoration with equal intelligence. The podium level opens into an adult infinity pool and shallow water pool that appear to dissolve into the Dubai skyline beyond as one of the tower's most photogenic and experientially powerful spaces. Families are catered for through a dedicated children's swimming pool paired with an Aqua Joy water splash zone, while the Little Marvels play area provides a curated outdoor environment for younger residents. Wellness is addressed through a yoga zone and a fully equipped gym, and the social dimension of community life is enriched through a floating pergola deck, outdoor seating areas, landscaped walkways, and abundant green spaces that soften the podium's urban edge. Residents also benefit from immediate proximity to Al Barari's cycling tracks and natural reserves, Majan Park, Majan Active Park, and the Dubai Polo and Equestrian Club, a constellation of leisure and green infrastructure. Project Highlights: The tower rises across 32 residential floors with a striking dark metallic geometric façade contrasting bold glass surfaces. A total of 789 residences span studio, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom apartment configurations across the entire development. Premium interiors feature Patagonia marble, Oakwood panelling, bronze trims, and signature green brushed steel throughout every residence. Residents enjoy direct road access to E311, Sheikh Zayed Road, Umm Suqeim Street, and Dubai-Al Ain Road. Downtown Dubai and Burj Khalifa are reachable within fifteen to twenty-five minutes from the tower's Majan address. The amenity deck features an infinity pool, children's splash zone, yoga area, gym, and landscaped pergola deck.

The concept favours not only visual grandeur, but also the creation of sophisticated interiors, highly customisable and developed to offer a level of comfort and refinement rarely found in the residential market. The initial typologies include two-and-a-half-bedroom residences, designed with functional layouts and a contemporary language, while always maintaining high standards of materials and finishes. Evolving in the range are three-bedroom units, which offer larger areas, harmoniously distributed rooms and rooms with large windows that allow unimpeded views of the Dubai skyline. On the upper levels, typologies of a frankly exclusive character emerge, such as the suspended mansions of four and six bedrooms, which occupy generous areas and provide a true experience of an independent house within a vertical tower. Some of these units include a private pool, cinema rooms, play areas, reading spaces and areas for wellness activities, such as rooms prepared for massages or fully equipped gyms. These residences are also distinguished by the high number of private parking spaces, which can vary between four and twelve, ensuring safety and practicality. At the top of the structure are the most emblematic residences of the project: large penthouses designed in full floors or in duplexes, with exceptional surfaces that far exceed the typical dimensions of luxury apartments. These units include infinity pools with panoramic views, formal and informal dining areas, main kitchens and secondary kitchens for service, private gyms, games rooms, offices, private lounges, suites with walk-in wardrobes, bathrooms covered in noble materials and protected outdoor areas to enjoy the view over the city. In some cases, residents have a private lift with direct access to the interior of the unit, ensuring the highest level of privacy. The building offers an extensive set of amenities that reinforce its position as a reference in the luxury real estate sector. These include large-design outdoor pools, a spa with treatment rooms, a sauna, a Turkish bath and relaxation areas, a gym equipped with state-of-the-art technology, lounges reserved for residents, meeting rooms and social spaces designed for private events. The tower also has concierge services available daily, valet assistance, permanent security staff, high-standard reception and advanced access control systems. The common areas have been carefully planned, using premium materials such as marble, worked metals and architectural lighting, creating an atmosphere of sophistication and exclusivity from the main atrium to the upper floors. The location in Business Bay guarantees a privileged connection to strategic areas of Dubai, such as Downtown, Dubai Canal, financial centres, cultural areas and some of the city's most popular gastronomic and commercial destinations. The proximity to the main traffic routes offers quick accessibility to the airport, beaches and other central neighbourhoods, making the development an ideal option for both permanent residence and investment. Taken together, this tower represents a unique proposition in Dubai's real estate landscape: it combines extremely refined design, typologies adapted to different lifestyles, international standard services and a highly prestigious location. title: 39XG+33H - Dubai - United Arab Emirates, Dubai
raw_area: 39XG+33H - Dubai - United Arab Emirates, Dubai, Dubai
description: The Archive by Imtiaz reimagines contemporary residential living through a distinctive concept inspired by literature, creativity, and intellectual wellbeing. At the heart of this unique development is a curated collection of approximately 10,000 real books, creating an environment where architecture and the art of reading come together. From an impressive two-storey library featuring an elegant spiral staircase to a dedicated writer's room designed to inspire creativity, every space reflects a thoughtful approach to modern living. Amenities and lifestyle The Archive offers a carefully curated selection of amenities designed to support physical wellness, relaxation, and creative inspiration. Fitness enthusiasts can enjoy a state-of-the-art gym shaped around Imtiaz's Raw Theory wellness philosophy, while the rooftop swimming pool provides a peaceful setting to unwind. Additional amenities include a BBQ lounge, outdoor cinema, landscaped garden with floating cabanas, and a mini golf course, offering opportunities for recreation and social gatherings. Dedicated reading lounges and thoughtfully designed communal spaces further distinguish the development, creating an atmosphere that encourages quiet reflection, meaningful conversations, and a deeper appreciation of everyday life. Interiors and finishes The interiors embrace a refined, literary-inspired aesthetic, balancing contemporary design with spaces dedicated to reading, creativity, and relaxation. Reading lounges provide inviting corners for quiet moments, while the rooftop salon, featuring a fireplace and comfortable deep seating, offers an elegant setting for socialising or unwinding. Modern finishes and high-quality materials complement the architectural concept, creating interiors that combine comfort, functionality, and understated sophistication. The overall design offers a distinctive residential experience for those who appreciate thoughtful spaces and a lifestyle centred on culture and wellbeing. Location and lifestyle Situated in Dubai Land Residence Complex (DLRC), The Archive benefits from a residential setting with access to major road networks, including Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road. This connectivity provides convenient routes to key destinations across Dubai, supporting both professional and personal lifestyles. The surrounding area offers access to shopping, entertainment, education, and leisure destinations. Popular attractions such as Dubai Outlet Mall, IMG Worlds of Adventure, and Global Village are accessible by road, while cultural and lifestyle destinations including Mohammed Bin Rashid Library, Dubai Design District, Dubai Creek Harbour, and Downtown Dubai provide further options for exploration. DLRC offers a residential atmosphere away from some of Dubai's busiest central districts while maintaining road access to business hubs, retail destinations, and other key areas of the city. Its combination of everyday convenience and connectivity makes it an option for professionals, families, and investors seeking a home within Dubai's expanding residential landscape. The Archive stands apart through its distinctive literary concept, thoughtfully designed amenities, and contemporary residences, offering a lifestyle where modern comfort meets creativity, culture, and wellbeing.

title: Majan, Dubai
description: Binghatti Titania at Majan is a high-rise 38-storey ultra-luxury advanced architectural excellence, above the podium levels, developed by leading Binghatti Developers . Laced with premium of the prime designed exclusive edition studios, 1 and 2-bedroom apartments to satisfy your luxury thirst to redefine the lifestyle. Being inspired from the Mythos tale, and rising with sovereign confidence as 3B+G+4P+32 residential floors with mech. and roof floor from the majan corridor. The tower commands immediate bold attention through a distinctive façade defined by a dark, metallic geometric grid that contrasts deliberately and dramatically against expansive glass surface, between structure and transparency that gives the building a rare character. The architectural philosophy extends far beyond its exterior geometry, threading through every interior surface with an equally precise design. The materials palette chose for the residences reads as a consideration curation of natural and refined elements. Patagonia marble in its two distinct expressions brings both dynamic veining and quiet textural richness to kitchen, bathrooms and entrance areas. Oakwood panelling introduces warmth and organic depth to living and bedroom walls; bronze trims add luminous finish detail to joinery and fixtures; and green brushed steel appears as a signature accent that ties the interior palette to the tower's broader identity. Interiors are conceived around open-plan spatial logic, with light treated not as an amenity but as the primary architectural material, its movement through floor-to-ceiling glazing creates a living, breathing quality of illumination across subtle neutral hues that shift from cream and sand to warm ivory across different times. The result is a residential atmosphere that feels simultaneously expansive and intimate, modern and enduring, a place where the design draws back deliberately to place the resident and their sense of stillness at the centre of every room. The amenity deck has been conceived as a comprehensive lifestyle environment that balances activation and restoration with equal intelligence. The podium level opens into an adult infinity pool and shallow water pool that appear to dissolve into the Dubai skyline beyond as one of the tower's most photogenic and experientially powerful spaces. Families are catered for through a dedicated children's swimming pool paired with an Aqua Joy water splash zone, while the Little Marvels play area provides a curated outdoor environment for younger residents. Wellness is addressed through a yoga zone and a fully equipped gym, and the social dimension of community life is enriched through a floating pergola deck, outdoor seating areas, landscaped walkways, and abundant green spaces that soften the podium's urban edge. Residents also benefit from immediate proximity to Al Barari's cycling tracks and natural reserves, Majan Park, Majan Active Park, and the Dubai Polo and Equestrian Club, a constellation of leisure and green infrastructure. Project Highlights: The tower rises across 32 residential floors with a striking dark metallic geometric façade contrasting bold glass surfaces. A total of 789 residences span studio, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom apartment configurations across the entire development. Premium interiors feature Patagonia marble, Oakwood panelling, bronze trims, and signature green brushed steel throughout every residence. Residents enjoy direct road access to E311, Sheikh Zayed Road, Umm Suqeim Street, and Dubai-Al Ain Road. Downtown Dubai and Burj Khalifa are reachable within fifteen to twenty-five minutes from the tower's Majan address. The amenity deck features an infinity pool, children's splash zone, yoga area, gym, and landscaped pergola deck.

title: Business Bay, Dubai
description: DaVinci Tower is the first residence in the world designed by Pagani Automobili, the Italian hypercar atelier known for engineering objects that are also works of art. This three bedroom duplex villa occupies the tower's ground floor on the Dubai Canal in Business Bay, seven minutes from Burj Khalifa and Downtown Dubai. The residence spans 429 sqm (4,618 sq ft) across two internal levels, connected by a private staircase, with a private pool set apart from the building's shared amenities. Interiors carry Pagani's own material language throughout: marble flooring on the principal level, engineered timber through the bedrooms above, and lacquered built-in joinery, all delivered unfurnished. DaVinci Tower rises 19 residential floors above Business Bay, with a rooftop pool, a fully equipped gym, and 24-hour concierge service. The development is scheduled for completion in December 2025, on a 100% freehold basis with no restrictions on foreign ownership. description: Azizi Lina is a contemporary residential development designed to combine modern architecture, everyday functionality, and comfortable urban living. Offering a selection of freehold studios and 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments, the development caters to a variety of lifestyle needs. Thoughtfully planned layouts, clean architectural lines, and bright interiors create a welcoming atmosphere, with an emphasis on making the most of every space. Amenities and lifestyle Azizi Lina offers a range of amenities designed to support fitness, relaxation, and social interaction. Residents can enjoy dedicated leisure and wellness facilities, spaces for gathering and recreation, and convenient access to integrated retail and entertainment options. These features contribute to a well-rounded residential environment where daily essentials, leisure, and community living come together. Interiors and finishes The apartments feature contemporary interiors, quality materials, and modern finishes that balance style with practicality. Fully equipped kitchens add everyday convenience, while fully furnished units offer a ready-to-enjoy living environment for homeowners and an appealing option for investors considering rental opportunities. Thoughtful layouts and coordinated interior details create comfortable spaces suited to modern lifestyles. Location and lifestyle Situated in Jebel Ali, Azizi Lina benefits from an established economic and industrial district with strategic connections to key parts of Dubai. description: Sei Saadiyat: 1-bedroom apartment offering approximately 78 sq m of space within a new residential development by Aldar in Saadiyat Cultural District, Abu Dhabi. The residence features a light interior palette with stone, wood, metal and woven textures, combined with clean forms and carefully balanced proportions. The development comprises six towers and 778 residences. The architectural concept was created by Jacobs, while the interiors were designed by Kettle Collective. The project combines stepped building volumes, landscaped courtyards, elevated gardens and a façade treatment shaped by light and shadow. Sei Saadiyat is located in the heart of Saadiyat Cultural District, approximately 3 minutes from Abrahamic Family House, 4 minutes from Zayed National Museum, and around 5 minutes from Louvre Abu Dhabi, Manarat Al Saadiyat, Berklee Abu Dhabi and Saadiyat Grove. Guggenheim Abu Dhabi, Natural History Museum Abu Dhabi and teamLab Phenomena are about 7 minutes away, while Yas Island is around 20 minutes and Zayed International Airport approximately 25 minutes away. With approximately 78 sq m of space, the 1-bedroom format is well suited to owner-occupiers and buyers considering future rental within Saadiyat Cultural District. Its proximity to the island's major cultural landmarks is one of the project's defining advantages. Handover is scheduled for Q4 2030 . The payment plan is structured as 50/50 , with 5% payable on booking, 45% during construction and the remaining 50% on handover. A key advantage of Sei Saadiyat is the combination of an Aldar development, a prime cultural district location and a distinctive architectural concept. Contact DDA Real Estate for current pricing, available layouts and full purchase details for this 1-bedroom apartment at Sei Saadiyat.

description: Altus by Emaar is a contemporary residential development designed to bring together modern elegance, urban convenience, and sustainable living. Featuring thoughtfully designed residences and a distinctive architectural style, the development offers a refined lifestyle complemented by expansive views and well-planned living spaces. With an emphasis on natural light, functionality, and environmental responsibility, Altus presents a modern approach to comfortable city living. The development offers a selection of 1, 2, and 3-bedroom residences, catering to individuals, couples, and families. Each home is designed with spacious layouts, contemporary bathrooms, generous storage, and balconies that extend the living experience outdoors. The interiors combine modern aesthetics with practical design, creating inviting spaces suited to everyday comfort and relaxation. Altus features fully finished residences with high-quality materials and equipped kitchens, allowing residents to enjoy a contemporary living environment with essential kitchen facilities in place. The apartments are unfurnished, giving homeowners the flexibility to personalise their interiors according to their preferences. Sustainability is an integral part of the development's design. Architectural features such as balconies, horizontal ledges, and tinted glazing help reduce direct solar exposure and support cooler indoor environments. The design also incorporates measures to preserve existing vegetation and improve water efficiency, including the collection of air-conditioning condensate and planter drainage for landscape irrigation. These thoughtful features reflect a commitment to creating a comfortable living environment while considering long-term environmental impact. Location and lifestyle benefits Situated in Dubai Creek Harbour, Altus enjoys a setting within one of Dubai's prominent waterfront master-planned communities. Spanning approximately eight square kilometres, the destination combines contemporary residences, landscaped open spaces, waterfront promenades, and lifestyle attractions in a thoughtfully designed urban environment. A major highlight is Creek Beach, a family-friendly waterfront destination featuring approximately 700 metres of white sand, leisure spaces, and opportunities to enjoy the outdoors. The surrounding community offers a blend of waterfront experiences, dining, retail, and recreational attractions, creating an appealing lifestyle for residents of different ages. Dubai Creek Harbour is also known for its ambitious architectural vision and connection to the historic Dubai Creek. Its combination of modern urban planning, waterfront scenery, and access to key destinations makes it attractive to both homeowners and investors seeking a contemporary address in Dubai. With its sustainable design features, modern interiors, and waterfront community setting, Altus by Emaar offers a distinctive residential experience that balances comfort, functionality, and contemporary elegance.

description: Burj Binghatti is an iconic ultra-luxury residential tower that represents a bold architectural statement within Dubai's skyline. Rising over 112 storeys, the development is distinguished by its striking crown-inspired pinnacle, created in collaboration with the renowned luxury watch and jewellery brand Jacob & Co. Its extraordinary architectural identity combines visionary design with an exclusive residential concept, positioning the tower as a landmark destination for luxury living. The project features an exceptional collection of two- and three-bedroom suites, alongside prestigious penthouses and sky villas, each designed to offer expansive interiors, panoramic views, and an elevated residential experience. Designed around privacy, exclusivity, and refined luxury, Burj Binghatti offers a lifestyle that extends beyond conventional high-rise living. Its premium residential spaces are thoughtfully planned to provide comfort, sophistication, and exceptional city views. Among its signature offerings are the Fleur de Jardin Sky Villas, featuring half-floor layouts across the upper levels and breathtaking 180-degree views of iconic landmarks, including Burj Khalifa and Dubai Creek. These exclusive residences create an extraordinary setting for those seeking privacy and distinction at the highest level. The interiors reflect an uncompromising approach to quality, featuring premium materials, sophisticated finishes, and meticulous attention to detail. Each residence is designed to create a timeless atmosphere where elegance meets functionality. Equipped kitchens provide modern convenience, while the unfurnished delivery allows homeowners to personalize their interiors according to their individual preferences. From expansive layouts to carefully selected finishes, every element contributes to a distinctive luxury living experience. Location Description & Benefits Located in Business Bay , Burj Binghatti occupies a prestigious address within one of Dubai's most established residential and commercial districts. Positioned alongside the Dubai Canal and just minutes from Downtown Dubai, the area is recognized for its impressive skyline, contemporary architecture, luxury hotels, and premium residential developments. Its central positioning offers convenient access to major destinations, including DIFC, Sheikh Zayed Road, and Dubai International Airport. Business Bay offers a vibrant lifestyle supported by an extensive selection of restaurants, cafés, luxury hotels, retail outlets, and leisure destinations. The Dubai Canal waterfront adds a scenic dimension to the neighbourhood, with promenades and walking paths providing opportunities for outdoor recreation and relaxation. Residents can also enjoy access to fitness centres, wellness facilities, and landscaped public spaces, creating a balance between the energy of city living and peaceful waterfront surroundings. The district has developed into a major business and lifestyle destination, attracting professionals, entrepreneurs, and international residents. Its proximity to Downtown Dubai, established commercial hubs, and key transport routes contributes to its continued residential appeal. Business Bay also benefits from a diverse rental market, supported by demand for centrally located homes and convenient access to Dubai's business districts. With its central address, waterfront surroundings, strong connectivity, and established urban infrastructure, Business Bay remains an attractive destination for both end-users and investors. Burj Binghatti adds an exceptional architectural landmark to this setting, combining exclusive residences, extraordinary views, and a distinctive luxury concept.

Beyond it, the living-and-dining room forms the social centre of the accommodation, with the balcony extending across the curved outer façade. RAK Central places the hotel between Ras Al Khaimah's commercial centre and its resort corridor. For an international buyer, the Executive Suite occupies the collection's deliberate middle position: the privacy of a genuine one-bedroom, the Hotel's highest floor for this layout and far more outdoor space than the Studio, without moving into the larger Presidential configuration. title: Majan, Dubai
description: Binghatti Titania at Majan is a high-rise 38-storey ultra-luxury advanced architectural excellence, above the podium levels, developed by leading Binghatti Developers . Laced with premium of the prime designed exclusive edition studios, 1 and 2-bedroom apartments to satisfy your luxury thirst to redefine the lifestyle. Being inspired from the Mythos tale, and rising with sovereign confidence as 3B+G+4P+32 residential floors with mech. and roof floor from the majan corridor. The tower commands immediate bold attention through a distinctive façade defined by a dark, metallic geometric grid that contrasts deliberately and dramatically against expansive glass surface, between structure and transparency that gives the building a rare character. The architectural philosophy extends far beyond its exterior geometry, threading through every interior surface with an equally precise design. The materials palette chose for the residences reads as a consideration curation of natural and refined elements. Patagonia marble in its two distinct expressions brings both dynamic veining and quiet textural richness to kitchen, bathrooms and entrance areas. Oakwood panelling introduces warmth and organic depth to living and bedroom walls; bronze trims add luminous finish detail to joinery and fixtures; and green brushed steel appears as a signature accent that ties the interior palette to the tower's broader identity. Interiors are conceived around open-plan spatial logic, with light treated not as an amenity but as the primary architectural material, its movement through floor-to-ceiling glazing creates a living, breathing quality of illumination across subtle neutral hues that shift from cream and sand to warm ivory across different times. The result is a residential atmosphere that feels simultaneously expansive and intimate, modern and enduring, a place where the design draws back deliberately to place the resident and their sense of stillness at the centre of every room. The amenity deck has been conceived as a comprehensive lifestyle environment that balances activation and restoration with equal intelligence. The podium level opens into an adult infinity pool and shallow water pool that appear to dissolve into the Dubai skyline beyond as one of the tower's most photogenic and experientially powerful spaces. Families are catered for through a dedicated children's swimming pool paired with an Aqua Joy water splash zone, while the Little Marvels play area provides a curated outdoor environment for younger residents. Wellness is addressed through a yoga zone and a fully equipped gym, and the social dimension of community life is enriched through a floating pergola deck, outdoor seating areas, landscaped walkways, and abundant green spaces that soften the podium's urban edge. Residents also benefit from immediate proximity to Al Barari's cycling tracks and natural reserves, Majan Park, Majan Active Park, and the Dubai Polo and Equestrian Club, a constellation of leisure and green infrastructure. Project Highlights: The tower rises across 32 residential floors with a striking dark metallic geometric façade contrasting bold glass surfaces. A total of 789 residences span studio, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom apartment configurations across the entire development. Premium interiors feature Patagonia marble, Oakwood panelling, bronze trims, and signature green brushed steel throughout every residence. Residents enjoy direct road access to E311, Sheikh Zayed Road, Umm Suqeim Street, and Dubai-Al Ain Road. Downtown Dubai and Burj Khalifa are reachable within fifteen to twenty-five minutes from the tower's Majan address. The amenity deck features an infinity pool, children's splash zone, yoga area, gym, and landscaped pergola deck.

description: Exclusive Beachfront Apartments with Installment on Siniyah Island, Umm Al-Quwain Siniyah Island, located off the coast of Umm Al Quwain in the United Arab Emirates, is a site of significant historical and ecological importance. Archaeological excavations have uncovered the oldest known pearl fishing town in the Persian Gulf on the island, dating back to the late 6th or early 7th century CE. Additionally, the discovery of an Eastern Christian monastery from the same period provides insight into the region's diverse cultural heritage. The island is also home to one of the largest remaining colonies of Socotra cormorants, highlighting its environmental significance. Recognizing its potential, the Umm Al Quwain government has initiated a development project to introduce leisure, hotel, and residential properties to Siniyah Island, aiming to blend its rich history with modern amenities. , are conveniently located just 10 minutes from Al Marjan Island, 30 minutes from Sharjah, 50 minutes from Downtown Dubai, and 60 minutes from Dubai International Airport. The project offers a luxurious seaside lifestyle, set amidst lush landscapes and serene surroundings. It seamlessly integrates natural beauty and refined architectural design, boasting pristine beaches with velvety white sands and crystal-clear turquoise waters. Residents enjoy direct beach and lagoon access, expansive views of the Arabian Gulf, and lush green vistas overlooking a meticulously designed 18-hole golf course. The development features premium amenities including an infinity swimming pool, an outdoor cinema, a state-of-the-art fitness centre, and multiple children's play areas. For leisure and relaxation, landscaped parks, tranquil gardens, and a vibrant community centre provide perfect spaces to unwind. Additionally, thrill-seekers can indulge in exhilarating water sports such as scuba diving, snorkeling, kite surfing, and paddleboarding. The retail boulevard offers a sensory feast with charming cafes and gourmet dining, enhancing the vibrant community atmosphere. Exclusive services such as a yacht club, a shopping mall, luxury resorts, and a helipad further elevate the sophisticated lifestyle experience provided by this prestigious island residence. The project offers elegantly designed interiors across a selection of premium 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments and duplexes, carefully crafted to blend modern comfort with sophisticated aesthetics. Each residence features contemporary layouts enhanced by spacious living areas and meticulous attention to detail. The interiors are equipped with stylish fitted wardrobes and fully integrated kitchen appliances, providing residents with convenience and luxury. Tower A exclusively offers fully furnished units, thoughtfully curated with tasteful furnishings and décor for immediate comfort and sophisticated living from day one. Towers B, C, and D present semi-furnished residences, allowing flexibility for personal touches to complement the refined interiors. description:
WHERE INNOVATION TURNS EVERY DAY INTO AN EXPERIENCE

What if your balcony could become a destination of its own? At Reef 998, living is reimagined around a patented idea that transforms outdoor space into an experience you can enjoy throughout the year.

Set in Dubai Land Residence Complex, Reef 998 introduces a distinctive approach to contemporary living through its patented Sunken Balconies and integrated outdoor cooling technology. Inside, studios and one- to three-bedroom residences are designed around modern comfort and practical elegance. But the real story begins when you step beyond your front door.

Imagine starting your morning with a workout at the Techno Gym or CrossFit zone, finding your balance in the yoga area, then moving into the day with a refreshing swim. For families, kids’ pools and playgrounds create spaces dedicated to play, while the jogging track brings movement into the rhythm of everyday life.

And then comes the part that makes Reef 998 feel different. An outdoor cinema turns ordinary evenings into open-air experiences. BBQ areas, floating lounges, sunken seating and hammock spaces create places to gather, relax and disconnect. For those who prefer a more active lifestyle, the rooftop expands the possibilities with padel, squash, cricket, a skate park and a multi-purpose court.

There is even space for modern productivity, with co-working areas designed for days when work follows you home. Every element has been brought together to create a community where wellness, recreation, social life and privacy coexist naturally.

With an extended payment plan of up to 5.5 years and a location connected to Dubai’s wider road network, Reef 998 offers an opportunity to experience a different side of city living.

title: WELCOME TO YOUR SAFTY HOME ENJOY AL FURJAN LIVING
description:
Imagine yourself living here...

Imagine opening your eyes and your balcony isn't a balcony. It's a private garden in the sky. Green plants wrapped around you, a big wicker egg chair, and soft fairy lights tangled in the leaves. No noise. No traffic. Just green, quiet, like you're in a resort.

You walk inside... It's fully furnished, premium finishes, everything is done. You walk into the bathroom and you feel like you walked into a spa. Marble, hidden LED glow under the sink, a big mirror, and a calm vibe that makes you forget you're in an apartment.

You go downstairs... The swimming pool is not a building pool, it's a resort. Sun deck, a cabana with woven pendant lights and golden glow, lit palm trees, and a space where you can sit with your family like you're on vacation every day.

Want to work out? The gym is not just a gym. It's floor-to-ceiling glass with the whole city in front of you, brand new equipment, and a quiet yoga area where you can breathe away from the world. Your kids have their own safe, closed play zone.

And at night? It's a whole different story. The pool glows blue, your balcony is full of golden lights, and the entire Dubai skyline lights up in front of you. Marina and JBR glowing in the background like you're watching a movie.

And the best part? You're in Al Furjan. That means the metro is at your doorstep. Sheikh Zayed Road and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road are 2 minutes away. Marina is 10 minutes, Ibn Battuta Mall is 5 minutes, and all your work, schools, and life are around you. It's the most in-demand rental area in Dubai right now. Everyone wants to live here.

So whether you live in it and feel that resort life every day... or you rent it out and get a high rental yield because everyone is looking for this area... you win.

This is not an apartment... This is a full resort life, with interest-free installments, pre-launch prices, and limited units.

*Imagine yourself living it... before someone else takes it.*

description:
This spacious corner three-bedroom apartment with a maid’s room is located on a middle floor of Peninsula Four – Tower B, in the heart of Business Bay. The residence enjoys open views toward the iconic Burj Khalifa and the Dubai Canal, creating a striking urban panorama from floor-to-ceiling windows and the private balcony. Positioned on a middle floor, the apartment offers both privacy and an elevated perspective over the waterfront surroundings.

The layout is generously designed for comfortable family living. As a corner unit, it benefits from additional natural light and an airy atmosphere throughout the living spaces. Each bedroom features its own en-suite bathroom, providing privacy and convenience, while built-in wardrobes offer ample storage. The apartment also includes a maid’s room, a dedicated laundry area, and a well-planned living and dining space designed for modern urban lifestyles.

Peninsula Four – The Plaza is part of the larger Peninsula master community and consists of two elegant 52-storey towers complemented by low-rise buildings with exclusive loft-style residences along the canal. The architecture is defined by minimalist glass façades and light-toned panels, creating a sleek contemporary look that integrates seamlessly with the waterfront setting.

Residents enjoy a comprehensive range of amenities including indoor and outdoor gyms, sauna and steam rooms, a squash court, a swimming pool with sun terrace, two jacuzzis, as well as a children’s pool and playground. The surrounding promenade features cafés, restaurants, and retail outlets within walking distance, creating a lively yet relaxed waterfront lifestyle in the center of the city. The project handover is scheduled for 2026.

For more information, updated availability, or to arrange a private presentation, please contact Denis Zhonochin.

description: Furnished Apartments with Burj Khalifa Views in Business Bay, Dubai Business Bay is a vibrant and upscale district in the heart of Dubai, known for its dynamic mix of luxury residential towers, high-end hotels, and premium office spaces. Strategically located along the Dubai Canal, it offers breathtaking skyline views, including the iconic Burj Khalifa. The area is a hub for business, leisure, and lifestyle, featuring world-class dining, shopping, and entertainment options. With excellent connectivity via major highways and the metro, Business Bay attracts professionals, investors, and residents seeking a modern urban lifestyle with easy access to Downtown Dubai and other key destinations. are strategically located with access to Sheikh Zayed Road, Al Khail Road, Al-A'amal Street, and Al Asayel Street. The apartments are just 4 minutes from Business Bay Metro Station, 5 minutes from Marasi Promenade, 9 minutes from Burj Khalifa and Dubai Mall, 10 minutes from The Dubai Fountain, 11 minutes from Dubai Opera and Museum of The Future, 14 minutes from Coca-Cola arena, 16 minutes from Dubai International Airport, 24 minutes from Jumeirah Beach Residence and Dubai Marina, 35 minutes from Al Maktoum International Airport. The project offers a modern and sophisticated living experience with an extensive array of luxurious amenities designed to enhance comfort and convenience. The exterior features a sleek, contemporary design with stunning views of the Dubai skyline. The building is equipped with an infinity pool, Jacuzzi, kids' pool, aquatic gym, and pool deck seating, complemented by a BBQ area, kids' play area, and a variety of sports facilities including a cricket pitch, trampoline arena, wall climbing, basketball court, and tennis/cricket training courts. A wellness club, beauty salon, kids' daycare, snooker zone, and library provide additional comfort and relaxation. The upper levels boast exclusive amenities such as a sky observatory deck, sky meditation area, and both indoor and outdoor party halls, with a rooftop featuring a golf simulator, arcade zone, and family seating. The development also includes a business centre, indoor gyms, jogging track, bowling center, and outdoor cinema, ensuring a well-rounded lifestyle for its residents. The project features fully furnished 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments, each designed to offer a luxurious and contemporary living experience. The interiors are carefully curated with high-end finishes and attention to detail. The living spaces are spacious, with open layouts that seamlessly connect the living room, dining area, and kitchen, creating a perfect environment for relaxation and entertainment. Each apartment is equipped with fitted wardrobes in the bedrooms and kitchen white goods, including a refrigerator, cooker, and washing machine, ensuring ease and functionality. The modern kitchens are designed with sleek cabinetry and high-quality materials for a sophisticated look. Additionally, the apartments offer the option of private pools on the balcony, giving residents the opportunity to enjoy stunning views while experiencing the ultimate in privacy and luxury. The bathrooms are designed with premium fixtures and finishes, further elevating the overall living experience. With every detail meticulously planned, these apartments provide the perfect blend of comfort, convenience, and style for those looking to live in the heart of Dubai's vibrant Business Bay. description: Reference: GTWW-T1251. Discover a new level of luxury in a sprawling residential complex of eight million square feet, situated in a prime area between some of the emirate's most striking areas. This residential space offers a unique balance between the tranquillity of a natural environment and the immediate proximity to the main urban, commercial and cultural centres of the city. Away from the noise, but within the reach of everything that matters, it provides a quality of life that is rare in a metropolitan context. The contemporary architecture features villas of great exclusivity, with several floors, rooftop and generous outdoor spaces, as well as modern apartments with expansive views of the water, the surrounding green areas and the iconic Dubai skyline. Each residence is designed with premium materials, efficient layout and large windows that maximise natural light and a sense of spaciousness. The lifestyle offered extends to a wide selection of amenities designed to provide well-being, conviviality, productivity and leisure. Among them are themed gardens, green trails, meditation areas, reading spaces, coworking areas and social squares. The complex also includes indoor and outdoor gyms, spa, massage rooms, sauna, swimming pools with rest areas, cabanas and submerged areas. For physical activities, paddle, squash and volleyball courts, climbing wall, multipurpose courts, golf simulators, training circuits and walking and running courses are available. Families have multiple spaces dedicated to children and young people, such as parks, interactive areas, game rooms, skate park and technology areas. Pets also have parks, washing areas, pet salon and dedicated services at their disposal. It is an environment designed for those looking for a life of high comfort and exclusivity, in a place where every detail has been carefully designed to provide a superior residential experience. title: Dubai Islands, Dubai
description: Allegro Park is a residential building by Mill Hill Developers on Dubai Islands, set where the coastline meets a green park setting. The architecture is designed to blend into its surroundings, with gentle façades, shaded balconies and open breezeways. The project offers one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments, as well as penthouses and townhouses, and every apartment features a private glass-sided plunge pool on the balcony. The amenity offer brings resort-style living to the building. Residents can enjoy a podium beach-edge pool with a natural sand entry, an adults' rooftop infinity pool and an adults' rooftop cinema, as well as a temperature-controlled podium cinema. A Technogym fitness centre, a spa and wellness centre with saunas, steam rooms and plunge pools, and a podium-level padel court support an active lifestyle, while a splash pad and a children's play area cater to families. Apartments are delivered semi-furnished with kitchen appliances. Interiors follow a modern and contemporary style that pairs natural palettes with refined textures, creating calm and light-filled living spaces with a resort-style lobby welcoming residents on arrival. Location description and benefits Dubai Islands is a waterfront destination off the coast of Deira, combining residential neighbourhoods with beaches, marinas, hotels and leisure facilities. The area offers a relaxed coastal lifestyle with open sea views and green spaces, while remaining closely linked to the established districts of the city. raw_area: The Orchard Place Tower A, The Orchard Place, District 12, Jumeirah Village Circle, Dubai
description:
Some places are built around buildings. Others are designed around the way you want to live.

In the heart of Jumeirah Village Circle, a contemporary European-inspired community rises with a different idea of urban living — one where architecture, greenery and everyday experiences come together to create a place that feels beautifully complete.

Imagine waking up to generous natural light, stepping onto your private terrace and beginning the day with your own quiet view of the community. With spacious residences, refined neutral interiors and terraces that can extend your living space outdoors, home becomes more than four walls. It becomes a private retreat within the city.

Then the day begins to unfold.

A 25-metre infinity pool with a submerged island invites you to swim, relax or simply let the afternoon disappear beside the water. The gym opens onto an outdoor area created for yoga, Pilates and moments of stillness, while the multifunctional paddle court adds energy whenever you feel like moving.

For evenings, the atmosphere changes.

Gather around one of the private barbecue spaces surrounded by landscaped greenery, meet friends in the dedicated meeting room, or simply take a quiet walk through the gardens as the lights begin to soften. Families have their own rhythm too, with a spacious kids club and outdoor cinema designed to give children a world of their own.

And then there is the rooftop.

For the select penthouses, expansive terraces and private swimming pools transform the highest levels into a more exclusive expression of life above the city. Here, the skyline becomes your backdrop, the terrace becomes your private outdoor room, and every sunset feels like an occasion.

With contemporary architecture, high ceilings, landscaped surroundings, concierge services and a location connected to Dubai's major roads and destinations, The Orchard Place brings together the things that matter most: space, comfort, connection and a sense of belonging.

description: Shoreline is a contemporary residential development designed to bring the comfort of private living together with the indulgence of a resort-inspired lifestyle. Drawing inspiration from the natural movement of water and the sculptural beauty of sand dunes, the development embraces an architectural concept that blends modern design with organic forms. Its thoughtful layouts and nature-inspired aesthetic create a tranquil residential environment where sophistication, comfort, and relaxation come together. Amenities and lifestyle Shoreline is designed around the principles of wellness, leisure, and everyday tranquillity. Carefully planned communal spaces and landscaped surroundings create a welcoming atmosphere, while thoughtfully integrated recreational facilities enhance the resort-style experience. The development's water-inspired design concept flows throughout its shared spaces, creating a sense of calm and exclusivity. With an emphasis on relaxation and contemporary convenience, Shoreline offers a lifestyle that allows residents to enjoy a holiday-inspired atmosphere within their own residential community. Interiors and finishes The residences feature contemporary interiors complemented by high-quality materials and modern finishes. Soft forms, elegant detailing, and a carefully coordinated colour palette reflect the development's nature-inspired architectural concept, creating inviting spaces that balance style with functionality. The island's distinctive landscape and seaside atmosphere create an appealing environment for those seeking a more relaxed pace of living away from the bustle of Dubai. A major attraction in the surrounding area is the Wynn Al Marjan Island resort, an anticipated landmark expected to strengthen Ras Al Khaimah's position as an international tourism and hospitality destination. The emirate also offers a diverse range of experiences, from the Hajar Mountains and desert landscapes to beaches, marinas, and waterfront promenades. Al Marjan Island benefits from road connectivity to Ras Al Khaimah's key destinations and links to Dubai and other emirates. Ras Al Khaimah International Airport also serves the wider region, supporting access for residents and visitors. With its coastal surroundings, expanding leisure offerings, and resort-oriented atmosphere, Al Marjan Island presents an attractive setting for both lifestyle buyers and investors exploring Ras Al Khaimah's evolving property market. description: Palace Residences Hillside Towers A & B sets a new standard for sophisticated living, combining timeless Arabesque-inspired elegance with the tranquillity of nature. Surrounded by lush landscapes and thoughtfully integrated into the prestigious Dubai Hills Estate community, the development offers a peaceful residential setting with convenient access to Dubai's key destinations. Its contemporary architecture features graceful curves, clean lines, and warm, earthy tones inspired by the natural beauty of the surrounding hills, creating an atmosphere of understated luxury and refined sophistication. The development presents an exclusive collection of branded one- to three-bedroom apartments and townhouses, thoughtfully designed to deliver privacy, comfort, and contemporary elegance. Interiors embrace a nature-inspired palette of soft beige, green, and brown tones, complemented by premium materials and carefully considered detailing. Dubai Hills Mall serves as a major lifestyle and entertainment destination within the community, featuring a diverse selection of retail outlets, restaurants, cafés, and leisure attractions. Residents also benefit from access to essential services, educational facilities, healthcare providers, and convenient road connections to key areas across Dubai. description: "Oria is a contemporary residential development by Emaar Properties located in Dubai Creek Harbour, adjacent to the Creek Beach district. The project comprises 163 residential units, offering one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments with total areas ranging from approximately 749 to 1,727 sq ft. The development features a waterfront-oriented setting with a creekside promenade and views of the district park and Creek Beach. Residents can enjoy access to recreational facilities, including children's play areas, an adventure playground, a cycling track, a skate park and sports courts, along with connections to public transportation, including an RTA ferry terminal and metro station. Starting prices are AED 1.7 million for one-bedroom apartments, AED 2.7 million for two-bedroom apartments and AED 3.7 million for three-bedroom apartments. The apartments feature balconies, while selected two-bedroom layouts include walk-in closets and the documented three-bedroom layouts offer walk-in closets, laundry rooms and study areas. Oria's location provides convenient access to key destinations across Dubai, with Ras Al Khor Wildlife Sanctuary approximately five minutes away, Downtown Dubai around 10 minutes away, Dubai International Airport approximately 15 minutes away and Al Maktoum International Airport around 35 minutes away. The development's staged payment plan extends from February 2024 through July 2028, incorporating construction-related milestones. Oria combines contemporary apartment living, recreational amenities and waterfront surroundings within the wider Dubai Creek Harbour community."

title: Dubai South Residential District, Dubai
raw_area: Dubai South Residential District, Dubai, Dubai
description: Project general facts This is a boutique residential building, with a ground floor and four residential floors. Inspired by the idea of composition, the architecture combines warm bronze tones, rounded corners and wide glazed balconies with slim railings, giving the facade a soft, horizontal rhythm. Slatted canopies crown the rooftop, and palm trees and planters soften the edges of the building and its terraces. The compact scale of the project creates a quiet, private atmosphere for residents. Amenities are designed for wellness, leisure and family life. The rooftop features an open swimming pool with sun loungers under a curved slatted canopy, alongside a rooftop lounge with sofas and low tables among landscaped planters. Residents also have a gym with views over the district, an outdoor yoga deck and a barbecue area for gatherings in the open air. Families benefit from a kids' pool and a dedicated kids' play area, while an elegant entrance lobby welcomes residents and guests. The building offers studios and two-bedroom apartments, which suits both single residents and small families. All residences are delivered fully furnished, with refined interiors in soft neutral tones, natural materials and warm lighting. Kitchens and living areas are arranged around natural light, and private balconies extend the living spaces outdoors, while the low-rise, boutique format keeps the building calm and private. Location description and benefits Dubai South Residential District is a master-planned residential area in the south of Dubai, developed around Al Maktoum International Airport and Expo City Dubai. The district combines low-rise residential buildings, green streets, parks and community facilities in a calm suburban setting, and it continues to grow as new homes, schools and retail are added around the airport and the Expo City business area. Road links connect the area with Emirates Road and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, giving access to Jebel Ali, Dubai Investments Park and the rest of the city. Al Maktoum International Airport, Expo City Dubai, Palm Jebel Ali and Dubai Parks and Resorts are among the major destinations within easy reach, and the wider Dubai South area also includes logistics and business zones that bring jobs close to home for many residents. The district appeals to buyers looking for an accessible entry point into a growing part of Dubai. Compact studios and two-bedroom apartments here suit young professionals, couples and small families who want a quiet residential setting, as well as investors interested in rental demand linked to the airport, the logistics hub and the continued development of Expo City Dubai. description: Avarra by Palace by Emaar introduces a refined expression of luxury inspired by the signature elegance of Palace Hotels & Resorts. The development presents an exclusive collection of 1, 2, 3, and 4-bedroom apartments, complemented by a prestigious 6-bedroom penthouse. Designed as serene private retreats, the residences combine contemporary architecture, expansive glass façades, and sweeping balconies that frame views of the sea, Burj Khalifa, and Dubai skyline. Every residence is thoughtfully crafted with premium materials, warm tones, and elegant detailing that reflect the refined craftsmanship associated with the Palace brand. Spacious layouts, generous natural light, and carefully considered transitions between living spaces create homes that feel both sophisticated and inviting, balancing contemporary style with everyday comfort. Avarra by Palace offers a lifestyle centred around wellness, leisure, and effortless relaxation. Residents can enjoy an infinity pool with panoramic views, a dedicated yoga zone, fully equipped gym, and outdoor fitness areas. Family-oriented amenities include a children's pool, kids' play area, multi-purpose room, BBQ and picnic spaces, and beautifully landscaped common gardens. The interiors continue the development's understated approach to luxury, featuring refined finishes, premium materials, and a timeless colour palette. Kitchens combine elegant design with modern functionality, while carefully selected flooring, cabinetry, fittings, and fixtures create a cohesive sense of quality throughout each residence. Every detail is designed to deliver a polished living experience without compromising warmth or comfort. Location Description & Benefits Business Bay is one of Dubai's most established mixed-use destinations, bringing together residential towers, commercial spaces, hospitality, dining, and leisure within a highly connected urban environment. Its proximity to Downtown Dubai and Burj Khalifa places residents close to some of the city's most prominent attractions, while direct access to Sheikh Zayed Road and Al Khail Road supports convenient connectivity across Dubai. The neighbourhood has evolved beyond its commercial identity into a vibrant lifestyle destination. Residents have access to an extensive selection of restaurants, cafés, hotels, fitness facilities, retail destinations, and entertainment venues, while the Dubai Water Canal introduces a more relaxed waterfront dimension to the surrounding urban landscape. The canal's promenades and waterfront spaces provide opportunities for walking, cycling, leisure, and enjoying the city's illuminated skyline. The combination of contemporary architecture, waterfront surroundings, and a diverse lifestyle offering makes Business Bay particularly appealing to both residents and investors. With its central position, strong connectivity, established amenities, and continued development, Business Bay offers a compelling blend of urban convenience and premium city living. Its combination of residential demand, commercial activity, and lifestyle infrastructure further strengthens its appeal as a destination for homeowners and investors seeking a dynamic Dubai address.

description: New Project by Tarrad is an elegant mixed-use residential tower that blends contemporary architecture with a warm, welcoming sense of home. Its refined facade of soft cream stone, bronze-toned vertical fins and gently curved edges gives the building a graceful and instantly recognisable silhouette. Private balconies with sleek glass balustrades extend the living space outdoors and create a perfect spot to unwind. Warm neutral tones, premium stone and elegant bronze accents carry the building's refined character from the facade all the way inside, delivering a truly polished and sophisticated living experience. Location description and benefits Jebel Ali is a renowned district in Dubai, United Arab Emirates, strategically set along the Arabian Gulf coastline. At its heart lies Jebel Ali Port, one of the world's largest container hubs, which has cemented the area's global significance in trade and commerce. Adding to its economic strength is the Jebel Ali Free Zone (JAFZA), a dynamic business and industrial hub that attracts multinational corporations with its favorable environment for growth and innovation. Alongside this commercial power, Jebel Ali features vibrant residential communities with modern amenities, schools, and leisure facilities, offering a balanced lifestyle for its residents. The district also benefits from excellent connectivity, seamlessly linked to the rest of Dubai through Sheikh Zayed Road and the Dubai Metro. This integration of trade, business, and residential life makes Jebel Ali a distinctive and multifaceted destination.

title: LIVE ABOVE THE ORDINARY, SURROUNDED BY GREEN
raw_area: The Orchard Place Tower A, The Orchard Place, District 12, Jumeirah Village Circle, Dubai
description:
Some places are built around buildings. Others are designed around the way you want to live.

In the heart of Jumeirah Village Circle, a contemporary European-inspired community rises with a different idea of urban living — one where architecture, greenery and everyday experiences come together to create a place that feels beautifully complete.

Imagine waking up to generous natural light, stepping onto your private terrace and beginning the day with your own quiet view of the community. With spacious residences, refined neutral interiors and terraces that can extend your living space outdoors, home becomes more than four walls. It becomes a private retreat within the city.

Then the day begins to unfold.

A 25-metre infinity pool with a submerged island invites you to swim, relax or simply let the afternoon disappear beside the water. The gym opens onto an outdoor area created for yoga, Pilates and moments of stillness, while the multifunctional paddle court adds energy whenever you feel like moving.

For evenings, the atmosphere changes.

Gather around one of the private barbecue spaces surrounded by landscaped greenery, meet friends in the dedicated meeting room, or simply take a quiet walk through the gardens as the lights begin to soften. Families have their own rhythm too, with a spacious kids club and outdoor cinema designed to give children a world of their own.

And then there is the rooftop.

For the select penthouses, expansive terraces and private swimming pools transform the highest levels into a more exclusive expression of life above the city. Here, the skyline becomes your backdrop, the terrace becomes your private outdoor room, and every sunset feels like an occasion.

With contemporary architecture, high ceilings, landscaped surroundings, concierge services and a location connected to Dubai's major roads and destinations, The Orchard Place brings together the things that matter most: space, comfort, connection and a sense of belonging.

While the Souks offer a nod to traditional Arabian commerce and vibrant marketplaces, and Seerah focuses on residential tranquility and wellness, Raseel acts as the modern, high-tech core. Travel Hubs: Global connectivity is a breeze. Why Invest in Nama 3? The 1-bedroom units in Nama 3 are designed with the modern minimalist in mind, featuring open-plan layouts, floor-to-ceiling windows that invite natural light, and premium materials throughout. As Sharjah continues to grow as a cultural and economic powerhouse, properties within integrated communities like Al Mamsha Raseel are expected to see significant capital appreciation and high rental yields. Whether you are a first-time buyer looking for a stylish sanctuary or an investor eyeing the lucrative UAE real estate market, this apartment in Nama 3 offers a lifestyle defined by convenience, luxury, and connectivity. description: The Arabian Gulf does not offer this view to everyone. At Samana Ocean Crest, it comes with your morning coffee. Fifty-six residences. One island. No compromise. Developed by Samana Developers - ranked fifth among Dubai's highest off-plan sellers by volume in the first half of 2025, with a portfolio valued at over AED 17 billion - Ocean Crest represents the developer's most considered coastal statement to date. Positioned on Dubai Islands, the Nakheel-masterplanned destination that redefines what island living means in this city, the project rises across eight residential floors with a discipline of scale that most developers would not allow themselves: just 56 residences, each one crafted with the attention that only boutique numbers permit. Many homes feature private terrace pools, interiors finished in warm natural stone, wood, and glass, and layouts calibrated around panoramic sea and skyline perspectives. Samana has built its reputation on delivering resort-style living as a lived experience rather than a marketing promise - and Ocean Crest is where that philosophy meets the Gulf itself. THE EXPERIENCE: Life at Ocean Crest operates at the cadence of the sea. Mornings open to the Arabian Gulf with no obstruction, afternoons unfold across a resort-grade amenity landscape, and evenings carry the particular stillness that only island addresses can offer. This is not urban living softened by a view. It is coastal living, fully committed. Private terrace pools - select residences with direct pool access from your own outdoor space Infinity pool and sun deck - a skyline-facing water environment designed for unhurried days Yoga studios and wellness spaces - dedicated areas for restoration alongside the water's edge Spa, sauna, and steam rooms - a full wellness facility integrated into the building's daily rhythm Children's splash pad and family zones - thoughtfully separated spaces for every generation Landscaped gardens and jogging tracks - green corridors woven into the island environment 24/7 concierge and artistic lobby - a resident arrival experience that sets the register from the first step THE INVESTMENT CASE: Dubai Islands is one of the few remaining large-scale waterfront destinations in Dubai where early capital allocation still carries meaningful upside - a Nakheel-developed master community with confirmed infrastructure, beach access, and a pipeline of hospitality and retail that will anchor long-term demand. WHO THIS IS FOR: This is for those who have spent enough time in landlocked buildings and have decided, with some finality, that the water is non-negotiable. description: Situated in DLRC next to Academic City, DLRC will be the prime Student Housing That will Pays 8-9% Gross Yields.
