It comes from four things working together: prices are low to buy, student demand is high, supply is short, and parents back the leases. Demand is much bigger than supply 27,000+ students across 26 universities, including Heriot-Watt, Amity, Middlesex, Wollongong and Canadian University Dubai Students come from 140+ countries, and most need private housing Fewer than 2,000 on-campus beds, which leaves 25,000+ students looking for rentals every year In short, far more tenants are looking than there are units, so rents stay firm and units don't sit empty for long. Long stays: undergraduates usually stay 3-4 years, and 75-85% renew Parents back the lease: 80%+ of international student leases carry a parental guarantee Fewer missed payments: 2-4% default or late payment, against 8-12% for young professionals Staff and faculty tenants: 2-3 year contracts give income all year round Handling the summer gap: Start leases in September, line up next year's tenants in March-April, and allow summer sublets. This keeps June-August vacancies low. description:
Some places are built around buildings. Others are designed around the way you want to live.

The gym opens onto an outdoor area created for yoga, Pilates and moments of stillness, while the multifunctional paddle court adds energy whenever you feel like moving.

And then there is the rooftop.

For the select penthouses, expansive terraces and private swimming pools transform the highest levels into a more exclusive expression of life above the city. Here, the skyline becomes your backdrop, the terrace becomes your private outdoor room, and every sunset feels like an occasion.

With contemporary architecture, high ceilings, landscaped surroundings, concierge services and a location connected to Dubai's major roads and destinations, The Orchard Place brings together the things that matter most: space, comfort, connection and a sense of belonging.

description: We offer for sale a 2-room apartment with a rental contract, with an area of 88 m² , in the popular Zabeel area. The apartment is located in the new residential complex 1 Residences. It is fully renovated and equipped with furniture and appliances. The offered apartment is on a high floor, with a well-thought-out and convenient layout, a spacious balcony, and panoramic views of the park. The bright interior is designed in a modern style in cool tones with marble and tiles. The apartment has 1 parking space in the underground garage. Starting price - EUR 585,830. There is currently an annual rental contract with monthly payments. The current return is 5-6% per year. There is potential to increase profitability by renting the apartment short-term. About the project 1 Residences is a complex of two original towers in the shape of the number "1" in the historic district of Bur Dubai. The 43-storey buildings are elegantly connected at the top levels by a skybridge. Construction of the project was completed in 2022. Infrastructure On the podium level of the complex and the top three floors, public areas with landscaping and premium amenities have been created for residents and guests of 1 Residences. These include swimming pools with lounge areas, fountains, children's playgrounds, a modern gym, a 340-meter running track on the 43rd floor, and much more. The 1 Residences complex is located in Al Kifaf, near Dubai's popular historic district of Bur Dubai. The area includes many historic sites: the Dubai Museum in 18th-century style, the historic Al Bastakiya quarter, and more. The active residence of the Emir of Dubai, Zabeel Palace, is also located here. The district's special attractions include the grand viewing platform Dubai Frame and Zabeel Park. The park can be considered a huge green oasis. There you will find dinosaur sculptures, illuminated gardens, an ice park with children's rides, barbecue pavilions, and a running track with non-slip coating and aroma diffuser. All these locations are within a 5-10 minute drive from the complex. It takes five minutes by car to reach Dubai's main highway, Sheikh Zayed Road, which runs along the coast. This highway provides quick access to any location in Dubai, as well as to the neighboring emirates of Abu Dhabi and Sharjah. The apartments in 1 Residences appeal to lovers of luxury and active lifestyles who want to enjoy comfort in a modern residential complex with unique architecture. The strategic proximity to the center of Dubai, business districts, and the airport highlights the convenience of living in 1 Residences.

description: Bay Grove Residences Phase 4 by Nakheel marks the final release of an exclusive waterfront community, offering an elevated coastal lifestyle within a beautifully planned island setting. Located in the Marina District on Island B, the development brings together contemporary architecture, landscaped surroundings, and direct access to Crystal Beach. Panoramic waterfront views, spacious terraces, and floor-to-ceiling windows create a seamless connection between the residences and their natural surroundings. The development offers a diverse selection of homes, including 1, 2, 3, and 4-bedroom apartments, alongside an exclusive penthouse. Each residence is thoughtfully designed with spacious layouts, generous natural light, and expansive outdoor spaces that enhance the experience of modern waterfront living. Residents can enjoy an extensive collection of resort-inspired amenities focused on wellness, recreation, and family experiences. Facilities include infinity and family swimming pools, a clubhouse with a cinema and games room, fitness and yoga studios, outdoor gyms, and indoor and outdoor children's play areas. A landscaped podium garden with shaded seating, a half basketball court, BBQ areas, and pet wash stations further enriches the community experience. Location Description & Benefits Dubai Islands is an ambitious waterfront destination comprising five interconnected islands, designed to bring together residential communities, hospitality, retail, and leisure experiences. Surrounded by beaches, landscaped areas, and expansive coastal views, the destination offers a distinctive island lifestyle with a strong connection to nature and the sea. The islands are connected to mainland Dubai through established road infrastructure, providing residents with convenient access to the city's key destinations. Downtown Dubai, Dubai Marina, and Palm Jumeirah are among the major lifestyle and entertainment hubs accessible by road, allowing residents to enjoy a quieter coastal environment while remaining connected to the wider city. The master development is planned to feature an extensive range of lifestyle attractions, including luxury hotels, waterfront restaurants, premium retail destinations, and recreational facilities. Its combination of beachfront surroundings and leisure infrastructure is designed to create a vibrant destination for residents and visitors alike. With its coastal setting, evolving infrastructure, and vision for an integrated island community, Dubai Islands presents an appealing proposition for homeowners seeking a relaxed waterfront lifestyle and investors looking towards the growth of an emerging destination. WHERE THE LAGOON BECOMES PART OF HOME
 

Some homes give you a beautiful view.

Others give you a completely different way of living.

Lunaya Terraces belongs to the second kind.

Around the terraces, the lifestyle unfolds through rooftop pools, wellness spaces, fitness facilities, gardens, children's areas, sports courts, cafés and everyday conveniences.

Imagine starting your morning with sunlight across your terrace.

A swim beside the lagoon.

An afternoon spent between wellness and greenery.

And an evening where the water becomes the backdrop to everything.

This is the beauty of Lunaya Terraces.

Not apartment living as you know it.

A more open, more natural and more refined way to experience home.

Where the terrace becomes your outdoor room.
Where the lagoon becomes your horizon.
And where every day feels beautifully connected to nature.

Lumen Realty presents a 1-bedroom apartment on a 40+ floor of Sobha Skyscape Altius, with views over Dubai Creek and the lagoon. Altius is the tallest and largest of the three Skyscape towers in Sobha Hartland II, a waterfront freehold community in Mohammed Bin Rashid City (MBR City). Sobha Realty builds every project in-house, from design to final finish, so the quality is consistent throughout.

Why this unit is worth a call

•Price: AED 1,625,000, about AED 2,567 per sq ft, for a Sobha waterfront address 10 minutes from Downtown.
•Views: Creek and lagoon views from the 41st floor. You’re high enough for open views and natural light, without high-floor prices.
•Payment: 60/40, with 40% due only on handover, so most of the cost is spread over the build.
•Clear records: The project is registered with the Dubai Land Department (DLD), payments go to an escrow account, and construction was 38% complete at the September 2026 DLD inspection.

Unit highlights

1 bedroom | 1 bathroom
Built-up area: 633 sq ft
Floor 40+
Creek and lagoon views
Private balcony and dedicated parking
Off-plan resale
Handover: Q4 2028 as advertised (the DLD register shows Dec 2029; subject to change)

Living at Altius

•Infinity pool and jacuzzi
•Kids’ play area and barbecue area
•Sports court
•Library, reading room and game room

Sobha Hartland II community
Sobha Hartland II is an 8-million-sq-ft freehold waterfront community. The Skyscape cluster has 1,852 homes across 4 buildings, and DLD has already registered 1,475 off-plan sales, which shows strong buyer demand. Altius has 735 homes, and about half are 1-bedrooms. That makes 1BRs the tower’s most common unit, so it’s easy to compare prices when you resell or rent out.

Location and drive times

•Ras Al Khor Wildlife Sanctuary: 5 km, 5 min
•Meydan Racecourse: 8 km, 10 min
•Downtown Dubai: 10 min
•Business Bay: 12 min
•Dubai International Airport: 16 km, 12 min
•Dubai Mall and Burj Khalifa: 10 km, 15 min

Who it suits

•Investors: a freehold Sobha unit at an entry-level price,lower than wht Sobha is currently selling at, on a 60/40 plan, with the steady rental demand that compact waterfront 1BRs near Downtown usually attract.
•End users: professionals and couples who want calm waterfront living with the city 10 minutes away on a high floor.

Why buy with Lumen Realty

•Support from your first viewing to handover
•We handle the DLD transfer and the Sobha NOC
•Mortgage and payment-plan advice
•After-sales and leasing support

 Contact Lumen Realty for the floor plan and the full payment breakdown.

description: Binghatti Spectre is a distinctive mixed-use development by Binghatti, introduced under the concept "A Presence Beyond the Visible." Rising above a shared podium, the development comprises two towers of contrasting heights defined by a sculptural and fluid architectural silhouette. The project brings together a selection of studios, one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments, Royal Suites, dedicated office spaces, and retail destinations, creating a contemporary environment that combines residential and commercial living with panoramic views across Dubai. Designed around an active and social lifestyle, Binghatti Spectre offers an extensive collection of leisure and wellness facilities. Residents can enjoy dedicated adult and children's swimming pools, a yoga and aerobics platform, paddle and tennis courts, and a jogging and sprint lane. Family-oriented spaces include a children's play area, comfortable sitting areas, and social nooks, while wellness facilities, lounge platforms, open lawns, and recreational tables including ping-pong provide opportunities for both relaxation and entertainment. The residences are thoughtfully planned across a range of layouts, from efficient studios to spacious three-bedroom homes. Larger residences offer enhanced features such as private pools, sky-open terraces, and dedicated laundry areas, creating a more elevated residential experience. Interiors are organized into distinct living, dining, and kitchen zones, with master suites incorporated into the larger configurations. Modern finishes, quality materials, and contemporary detailing complete the homes, which are delivered unfurnished to allow residents to personalize their living spaces. Location Description & Benefits Located in Al Jaddaf , Binghatti Spectre benefits from an emerging waterfront neighborhood positioned along Dubai Creek. The area occupies a strategic location between the historic districts of Old Dubai and the city's established business and lifestyle destinations, including Downtown Dubai and Business Bay. This central positioning provides convenient access to major road networks such as Sheikh Zayed Road and Al Khail Road, while Dubai Metro and Creek transport connections further enhance accessibility. Al Jaddaf offers a distinctive combination of heritage, culture, waterfront surroundings, and modern urban development. The neighborhood is connected to Dubai Creek, one of the city's most historically significant waterways, while nearby cultural destinations add to its appeal. The Jameel Arts Centre contributes to the area's growing creative and cultural identity, creating an environment that extends beyond conventional residential living. The community continues to develop as a vibrant residential and commercial destination, with modern apartment buildings, waterfront residences, landscaped walkways, retail outlets, restaurants, and leisure facilities. Its proximity to Dubai International Airport is another major advantage, particularly for frequent travelers and international residents. With its central location, growing waterfront appeal, strong connectivity, and proximity to Dubai's established business and lifestyle districts, Al Jaddaf offers attractive long-term potential for both end-users and investors. Binghatti Spectre combines this strategic setting with distinctive architecture, diverse residence options, and resort-style amenities, creating a contemporary destination designed for modern urban living.

description: Project general facts This is a contemporary residential development inspired by the timeless elegance of French architecture, where refined design meets modern comfort in a harmonious living environment. Thoughtfully crafted with graceful proportions, clean architectural lines, and beautifully landscaped surroundings, the project creates a peaceful sanctuary that balances sophistication with everyday functionality. Spacious residences are filled with natural light through open-plan layouts and expansive windows, offering bright, elegant interiors designed to foster comfort, tranquility, and a true sense of home. Residents enjoy a carefully curated collection of amenities that promote wellness, relaxation, and family living. Landscaped green spaces, walking paths, tranquil courtyards, a contemporary fitness center, meditation and recovery areas, and dedicated children's play zones create a vibrant community where every generation can thrive. Every element has been designed to encourage an active, balanced lifestyle while providing peaceful spaces for connection, recreation, and everyday wellbeing. The residences feature modern interiors finished with high-quality materials, elegant detailing, and integrated smart home technology that enhances comfort and convenience. Bright open spaces, bespoke storage solutions, and refined finishes create a timeless living environment that combines style with practicality. Kitchens come fully equipped with integrated appliances, while the residences are delivered semi-furnished, offering built-in furniture and essential interior elements that provide the perfect foundation for personalized living. Location description and benefits Dubai South - is a dynamic and strategically planned district located in the southern part of Dubai. It serves as a major hub for economic, commercial, and logistical activities, designed with a vision to support the growth of various industries. One of its standout features is its proximity to the Al Maktoum International Airport, the world's largest airport in terms of cargo volume, making it a key player in the global logistics and aviation sectors. In addition to its logistical prowess, Dubai South is home to the Dubai Expo 2020 site, which served as a testament to the district's capacity to host large-scale global events. The Expo site has now transitioned into a legacy district, offering a wide range of amenities and infrastructure, including residential communities, educational institutions, and recreational facilities. Dubai South's commitment to sustainability is evident in its green initiatives, with a focus on eco-friendly urban planning and energy-efficient buildings. Dubai South continues to grow as a thriving business and residential hub, attracting both international and local investors. Its strategic location, state-of-the-art infrastructure, and diverse range of opportunities make it a compelling destination for businesses and individuals alike, contributing to the ongoing development and economic diversification of Dubai. Student rentals near Dubai International Academic City (DIAC) earn 8-9% gross yields. That's 2-3 points more than most of Dubai's residential market. It comes from four things working together: prices are low to buy, student demand is high, supply is short, and parents back the leases. Demand is much bigger than supply 27,000+ students across 26 universities, including Heriot-Watt, Amity, Middlesex, Wollongong and Canadian University Dubai Students come from 140+ countries, and most need private housing Fewer than 2,000 on-campus beds, which leaves 25,000+ students looking for rentals every year In short, far more tenants are looking than there are units, so rents stay firm and units don't sit empty for long. Long stays: undergraduates usually stay 3-4 years, and 75-85% renew Parents back the lease: 80%+ of international student leases carry a parental guarantee Fewer missed payments: 2-4% default or late payment, against 8-12% for young professionals Staff and faculty tenants: 2-3 year contracts give income all year round Handling the summer gap: Start leases in September, line up next year's tenants in March-April, and allow summer sublets. This keeps June-August vacancies low. Why DLRC beats Dubai Silicon Oasis 20-30% cheaper to buy, which adds about 1-1.5 points of yield straight away Rents as high or higher (AED 60-65K against 58-62K) Room to grow: DLRC is still an emerging area, so prices have more room to rise than in mature DSO Metro coming: the Academic City station on the Dubai Metro Blue

description: Portside Square is a distinctive waterfront development set within the historic Mina Rashid, where contemporary architecture takes inspiration from the movement and rhythm of the sea. Comprising three sculptural towers - Portside Residences I, II, and III - the development is characterised by fluid lines, soft contours, and shimmering façades that interact beautifully with natural light. Its architectural design creates a harmonious relationship between sea, sky, and structure, offering a refined residential environment with open layouts, expansive glazing, and panoramic views. The development presents a lifestyle centred around wellness, leisure, and social connection. Residents can enjoy leisure and lap pools, landscaped decks, a dedicated fitness pavilion, and spa and sauna facilities. Additional amenities include yoga areas, co-working spaces, cinema and games lounges, and a dedicated children's club, creating an environment that caters to different lifestyles and age groups. Outdoor spaces are thoughtfully integrated throughout the community, with jogging paths, landscaped garden courtyards, and marina-facing lounges offering inviting places to relax, exercise, and connect. The combination of wellness facilities, recreational spaces, and social areas creates a balanced lifestyle with a distinct waterfront character. The residences feature contemporary interiors finished with high-quality materials, natural textures, and refined detailing. Equipped kitchens incorporate premium appliances, combining modern functionality with elegant design. Delivered unfurnished, the homes offer residents the flexibility to personalise their interiors while benefiting from a sophisticated architectural foundation and carefully selected finishes. Location Description & Benefits Dubai Maritime City is a distinctive waterfront destination that combines maritime infrastructure, commercial activity, and emerging residential developments. Strategically positioned near Dubai's established urban districts and major port facilities, the area is evolving into a specialised maritime hub while introducing new opportunities for waterfront living. The district has traditionally supported a wide range of marine-related industries, including shipbuilding, vessel maintenance, marine engineering, and maritime services. Its infrastructure includes specialised shipyards, dry docks, and facilities for marine equipment and service providers, alongside educational and training institutions that support the maritime sector. Its strategic position near Dubai's key ports and transport networks provides important connectivity for maritime businesses and international trade. At the same time, its proximity to the city's established districts allows residents and professionals to benefit from access to commercial centres, retail destinations, dining, and everyday conveniences. As Dubai Maritime City continues to develop, the combination of its waterfront setting, specialised commercial infrastructure, and growing residential offering is creating a distinctive urban environment. It presents an interesting proposition for those seeking a contemporary lifestyle within a developing coastal destination, supported by its strategic position within Dubai.

title: Ellington Portside Square
description:
Portside Square is developed by Ellington in Mina Rashid, a historic port district that opened in 1972 and now includes a marina and cruise terminal. The scheme has three residential towers, named Portside Residences I, II and III, each with a ground floor, a podium, 16 residential floors and a roof level, and curved faÃ§ades drawn from the movement of wind and water. Its 408 homes range from studios of 396 sq ft to four-bedroom penthouses of 3,441 sq ft, with one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments and two-bedroom units with a study in between.

Apartments are delivered with equipped kitchens and are otherwise unfurnished. Studios and one- and two-bedroom homes come with one parking space, and three- and four-bedroom homes with two. A first-floor amenity deck has a leisure pool, a kids' pool, cabanas, a running track, an outdoor fitness area and gardens. The pavilion adds a cinema and games lounge, an arcade, co-working pods, a spa with saunas and hot and cold plunge pools, yoga and Pilates areas, a fitness studio with a juice bar and a clubhouse. The Queen Elizabeth 2 is about a minute's drive away, Sheikh Zayed Road six minutes, and Downtown Dubai, Dubai World Trade Centre and Dubai International Airport around 10 minutes.

The location links Mina Rashid's maritime heritage with short drives to the city's business districts, including DIFC at about 14 minutes. Homes are offered on a freehold basis, and the project is registered with the Dubai Land Department. The payment plan asks for 20% on booking, 50% during construction and 30% on handover, with completion expected in Q4 2029.

description:
Legado by Prescott is a residential tower by Prescott in JVC (Jumeirah Village Circle). It rises 34 storeys, with two basements, a ground floor and five podium levels below 26 residential floors, behind a sleek glass facade. The building holds 343 homes: studios, one-bedroom apartments, two- and three-bedroom apartments with a maid's room, and two- and three-bedroom sky villas. One-bedroom apartments start from 803 sq ft, and two-bedroom apartments range from 1,493 to 1,543 sq ft.

The lobby offers a lounge with 24/7 concierge and valet services. Facilities are spread across three floors: a kids' splash park, kids' pool, kids' basketball court and jogging track on the first floor; a clubhouse, library, co-working hub, fitness studio, multilevel cinema and coffee bar on the 14th floor; and a 35-metre infinity pool, sunbathing deck, cabanas, table tennis and meditation decks on the 24th floor. Circle Mall is about 10 minutes away, and Hessa Street, Al Khail Road and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road are all close by.

The project suits buyers looking for a family-oriented tower in JVC with a broad set of shared facilities. Prescott has been active in Dubai since 2006 and has delivered projects such as Prime Residency and Prime Views. The payment plan is 20% on booking, 20% during construction and 60% on handover, which is expected in Q1 2028.

title: Ras Al Khor, Dubai
description: Project general facts Sanctuary is a refined residential development set within the prestigious Meydan district, uniquely positioned beside the Ras Al Khor Wildlife Sanctuary. The project's architecture reflects modern sophistication, with a sculpted façade of glass and clean geometry designed to maximize natural light and panoramic views. Sanctuary offers a rare balance between urban elegance and nature, providing residents with uninterrupted vistas of the Dubai skyline and protected natural landscapes, while remaining minutes from Downtown Dubai and major city arteries. The project features an extensive collection of resort-style amenities thoughtfully distributed across dedicated lifestyle levels. Residents enjoy landscaped serenity gardens, waterfall features, sunken island pools, infinity pools, outdoor fitness areas, kids' pools and play zones, BBQ areas, outdoor cinema, jacuzzi, spa-style relaxation pools, and sky gardens with observation decks. Indoor amenities include a state-of-the-art gym, sauna, indoor cinema, games area, and family-friendly communal spaces, creating a holistic living environment focused on wellness, leisure, and community. Interiors at Sanctuary are designed to reflect calm, comfort, and contemporary luxury. Living spaces are bright and spacious, enhanced by large windows that frame natural and skyline views. The residences are delivered without furniture, and interior specifications follow a standard of high-quality finishes with modern materials, aligned with the project's premium positioning. The overall interior concept emphasizes timeless design, functional layouts, and a serene atmosphere that complements the project's nature-inspired setting. Location description and benefits Ras Al Khor is one of Dubai's hidden gems, where urban convenience meets the untouched beauty of nature. Located just minutes from the city's bustling center, this district is best known for the Ras Al Khor Wildlife Sanctuary, a protected reserve that is home to thousands of migratory birds, including the iconic pink flamingos. The area's unique charm lies in its serene landscapes, offering residents and visitors a peaceful retreat from the dynamic energy of Dubai while still being well-connected to major landmarks and attractions. Beyond its natural wonders, Ras Al Khor is an emerging residential and commercial hub, offering a blend of modern infrastructure and tranquil surroundings. The district features a mix of upscale developments, spacious villas, and waterfront residences, all designed to provide a harmonious balance between luxury and sustainability. With easy access to Dubai Creek, Downtown Dubai, and major road networks, Ras Al Khor ensures a seamless lifestyle that combines convenience with scenic beauty. As Dubai continues to grow, Ras Al Khor remains a testament to the city's commitment to preserving its natural heritage while embracing modern progress. Future developments in the area promise to enhance its appeal with new residential communities, leisure destinations, and cultural attractions. Whether you are drawn to its stunning wildlife sanctuary, its picturesque waterfront views, or its growing urban landscape, Ras Al Khor offers a unique living experience where nature and city life coexist in perfect harmony.

raw_area: Cove at Lunaya Terraces, Lunaya Terraces, Saih Shuaib 1, Jebel Ali, Dubai
description:
WHERE THE LAGOON BECOMES PART OF HOME
 

Some homes give you a beautiful view.

Others give you a completely different way of living.

Lunaya Terraces belongs to the second kind.

Set within the nature-led world of Lunaya in Jebel Ali, this refined collection of low-rise residences brings a new expression of waterfront living to Dubai. Here, architecture rises gently around water, gardens and open skies, creating a home that feels connected to nature from every angle.

The experience begins with the terraces.

Generous private outdoor spaces extend the living room beyond its walls, while floor-to-ceiling windows invite natural light deep into the interiors. With one-, two- and three-bedroom residences, Lunaya Terraces combines contemporary elegance with the openness and privacy usually associated with villa living.

Then there is the landscape.

A remarkable 900,000 sq. ft. of swimmable lagoons forms the heart of Lunaya, surrounded by greenery and connected through walking and cycling routes. Around the terraces, the lifestyle unfolds through rooftop pools, wellness spaces, fitness facilities, gardens, children's areas, sports courts, cafés and everyday conveniences.

Imagine starting your morning with sunlight across your terrace.

A swim beside the lagoon.

An afternoon spent between wellness and greenery.

And an evening where the water becomes the backdrop to everything.

This is the beauty of Lunaya Terraces.

Not apartment living as you know it.

A more open, more natural and more refined way to experience home.

Where the terrace becomes your outdoor room.
Where the lagoon becomes your horizon.
And where every day feels beautifully connected to nature.
